title: Chinese AI Just Grabbed Half the US Market (Nobody Noticed)
description:
Chinese AI models have quietly taken almost half the American market and barely anyone noticed 🔥

On OpenRouter their share is creeping toward 50%. In february it crossed 30, and just a year ago it was sitting around ten. The whole thing is basically a price war, DeepSeek and Z ai run about 70% cheaper than the US models and on regular everyday tasks they hold up totaly fine.

The wild part, a startup called Lindy dropped Claude completely and moved to DeepSeek, and their CEO says they saving millions ✨

There is still a real gap on the hard stuff, roughly six months by the benchmarks. But for routine work? doesnt really matter anymore 😅

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
